title: Subtle Misogyny Detection and Mitigation: An Expert-Annotated Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on binary misogyny classification, continuous severity score regression, and automated text mitigation (rewriting) using an expert-annotated dataset of movie subtitles (the Biasly dataset).

Annotating dataset examples for intersectional, identity-based misogyny (combining gender bias with race, ethnicity, religion, class, immigration status, or disability) as part of a multi-class taxonomy.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing dataset examples for transmisogyny and homophobia to capture prejudice against gender nonconformity within the overarching misogyny annotation framework.
